notes.title: Gas Station Simulator with a release date!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Our friends over at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/DRAGO]DRAGO entertainment[/url] have been working on a new simulation game that is being released very soon! As we are all part of one big developer family, we would like to spread this exciting news. [b]Their Gas Station Simulator is being released on 15/09/2021 on Steam.[/b] 

Visit their Steam page below for more info!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149620/Gas_Station_Simulator/
